name: dsh-latex2office
description: LaTeX to Office formula tools: latex2office_insert (LaTeX formulas as native OMML equations or rendered images into existing .docx/.pptx; positions end/after_text/before_text/after_paragraph; atomic batch; numbered equations; auto .bak backup; readback verification), latex2office_generate (new .docx from formulas), latex2office_preview (render formula to PNG). Engine: pandoc + python-docx/python-pptx + LibreOffice headless.
